extensionDescription.message: Capture the job posting you are looking at, keep it in your browser, and send it to your own Postulo for review when you say so. Nothing goes anywhere else.

postuloUnreachable.message: Postulo cannot be reached: what you send waits in this browser until it answers.

lastListed.message: As Postulo last listed them, on $WHEN$.

captureHint.message: The page is read here, in your browser. Your Postulo, once set up, is asked only whether it already holds the page's postings, by their address, title and company; the page goes when you send it.

allowing.message: Allowing the extension to reach your Postulo…

noPermission.message: Without permission to reach your Postulo, nothing can be sent.

captured.message: Captured. Review it before it becomes a listing.

instanceHint.message: The address you open it at. https, unless it runs on this machine.

tokenHint.message: Made under $PATH$ in Postulo, with the $SCOPE$ scope and nothing more. It is kept on this device only, never synced through a browser account.

shortcutHint.message: Pressing the button, or $SHORTCUT$, reads the page you are looking at, here in the browser. No page is read until you ask, and nothing goes anywhere but your own Postulo: it is asked whether it already holds the posting, by its address, title and company, and is sent the page when you say so.

tokenMissing.message: Paste the token Postulo showed you.

saved.message: Saved. The button will now send pages to $HOST$.

savedNoPermission.message: Saved, but the browser refused permission to reach it; allow it in the extension's permissions.

asking.message: Asking Postulo who this token is…

addressRefused.message: Permission to reach that address was refused.

lacksCaptures.message: It lacks the captures scope, so it cannot capture.

noCredentialsInAddress.message: Leave the user name and password out of the address: it would never connect, and the password would be shown in the popup.

tokenTooWide.message: This token can also: $SCOPES$. The extension needs the captures scope only: issue a token with that scope alone and revoke this one.

permissionRefused.message: Postulo's address was not allowed, so nothing was sent. The capture is kept and waits: allow the address and press Send again.

enterAddress.message: Enter the address of your Postulo.

notAnAddress.message: That does not look like a web address.

httpsOnly.message: Use https for anything that is not on your own machine: the token travels with every request.

tokenRefused.message: Postulo does not accept this token. Check it under $PATH$.

notAllowed.message: This token is not allowed to capture.

tooMany.message: Too many captures in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

notWebPage.message: Only web pages can be captured.

unreadable.message: The page could not be read. Some pages block extensions.

notPostulo.message: That address answered, but not as Postulo. Check the address, and any sign-in page in front of it.

addressTooLong.message: This page's address is longer than Postulo accepts, even without the part after the “#”, so the capture was not sent. Add the posting in Postulo by hand instead.

reviewHint.message: This is what was read from the page. Correct anything that is wrong. Your Postulo is asked only whether it already holds this posting, by the address, title and company read; the page and your corrections go when you send it.

notConnected.message: Not connected to a Postulo yet: what you capture is kept in this browser.

kept.message: Kept in this browser. Send it to Postulo whenever you are ready.

storageFull.message: This browser's storage for Postulo is full. Send or delete some captures, then try again.

alreadyKept.message: You kept this page already and have not sent it: this is your version.

nothingRead.message: Nothing could be read from this page. Fill in what you know. Your Postulo is asked only whether it already holds the page's address; what you fill in goes when you send it.

waiting.message: Postulo cannot be reached right now. It is kept in this browser and sent as soon as Postulo answers.

waitingOffline.message: The testing switch is on, so it waits in this browser. It goes once the switch is off.

waitingAccount.message: It is kept in this browser and sent once that is fixed.

sendNeedsSetup.message: Kept in this browser, to be sent once your Postulo is set up.

capturesIntro.message: Postings you captured, kept here until they reach your Postulo. What you send goes as soon as Postulo can be reached.

nothingKept.message: Nothing is kept in this browser.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete this capture? It has not reached Postulo, so it exists only here.

offlineLabel.message: Act as if Postulo cannot be reached

offlineHint.message: For testing. While this is on, nothing is sent: captures wait in this browser exactly as they would with Postulo down, and go once it is off.

offlineOn.message: The testing switch is on: nothing is sent to Postulo.

offlineOff.message: The testing switch is off: what is waiting goes to Postulo now.

logHint.message: What the extension did, to find out why something did not work. It holds no token and nothing from the pages.

tickHint.message: Tick the ones worth keeping. Each becomes its own capture, read again by Postulo.

refusedSome.message: $COUNT$ were refused; the list of captures says why.

knownListing.message: Captured before: in your listings since $WHEN$ as $TITLE$.

knownCapture.message: Already waiting for review in Postulo, since $WHEN$.

knownSimilar.message: A listing with this title at this company exists: $TITLE$.

pictureOffer.message: Postulo can keep a picture of the whole page as you see it, signed in or not. Send one?

pictureNotKept.message: Postulo did not keep the picture. The capture itself is unaffected.

pictureTooBig.message: The page is too large to send as a picture.

pictureFailed.message: The page could not be drawn. Is it still the one you captured?

languageHint.message: Every language but English is a draft that no speaker has reviewed yet. Takes effect at once, without Save.

savedOtherAddress.message: Saved. $COUNT$ captures were waiting for the other address: send them again from Captures in this browser.

forgotten.message: Forgotten. This browser no longer holds an address or a token. The captures are kept, and none will be sent.

fillTokenHint.message: A second token that may read your details, to fill the form on the page you are looking at. Leave it empty and the extension cannot fill forms. It is used only when you press the button, and kept on this device only.

fillHint.message: Puts your name and email into the empty fields it recognizes, and marks them. Nothing is submitted: you read it and send it yourself.

filled.message: Filled $COUNT$ fields, marked with a blue outline. Read them, then send the form yourself.

filledNothing.message: Nothing here was recognized as a field to fill, or every field already had something in it.
